project.name: blog — From Big Bang to ChatGPT
project.description: A free digital textbook / interactive course that takes the reader from Stone Age tools and the history of math and machines, through the math of deep learning, to how modern LLMs actually work. PHP templates + vanilla JS, served statically; interactive in-browser visualizations throughout.

nodes.name: .htaccess
nodes.summary: Apache config: rewrites .php-less pretty URLs to the underlying .php file, blocks direct access to .search_cache.json, and auto-prepends mobile-prepend.php into every response so mobile.css/mobile.js load on all pages.

nodes.name: .user.ini
nodes.summary: Per-directory PHP runtime override that sets auto_prepend_file to mobile-prepend.php as a fallback for servers that do not honor the .htaccess php_value directive.

nodes.name: art.txt
nodes.summary: One-line scratch note holding a single external URL (an SBMA Underhill-AI event page) with no other content.

nodes.name: asanai_blog_proxy.php
nodes.summary: Self-contained reverse proxy that fetches any path under asanai.scads.ai/blog over cURL, validates the target to block SSRF, and rewrites relative src/href and in-JS asset paths so proxied HTML/JS keeps loading through the proxy.
nodes.languageNotes: Procedural PHP; uses cURL with FOLLOWLOCATION, a MIME map keyed on file extension, and preg_replace_callback to redirect asset references through itself.

nodes.name: attention_engine.js
nodes.summary: Large interactive multi-head self-attention engine for the Transformer lesson: runs a real QKV forward pass over tokens, renders per-head attention-weight matrices with LaTeX annotations, an 'attention path visualizer' (APV) arc view, and hooks for provenance/TDA tooling.
nodes.languageNotes: Single AttentionEngine class with a static hook registry (onForward/_fireForwardHooks) so external tooling can observe every forward pass; registers instances into window.__apv_instances and drives rendering through layered tab builders.

nodes.name: AttentionEngine
nodes.summary: The attention computation + rendering engine: holds QKV/output weights, runs the causal multi-head forward pass, and renders per-head weight matrices and context vectors into the lesson's DOM.

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: Runs one attention forward pass: projects h0 into Q/K/V, slices per-head, scores (with causal mask), softmaxes, and computes per-token context vectors, then fires registered forward hooks.

nodes.name: renderUI
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the on-screen attention visualization, dispatching to unified layer tabs or the fallback tab builder and updating per-layer content as head data changes.

nodes.name: onForward
nodes.summary: Static public hook: registers a callback invoked after every forward pass with the engine, head data, hidden state, tokens and token strings, letting TDA/provenance tooling subscribe without touching rendering.

nodes.name: dot
nodes.summary: Matrix multiplication used for the QKV/output projections, with defensive shape checks that return empty results on malformed input.

nodes.name: softmax
nodes.summary: Numerically-aware softmax that normalizes the attention scores of a row into weights summing to 1.

nodes.name: bildquellen-pruefung.txt
nodes.summary: Image source-and-license audit log: per-image records (URL, license via the Commons API, author, local filename, lesson of use, and OK/UNCLEAR status) documenting provenance and licensing for every figure in the book.

nodes.name: bpe.js
nodes.summary: Self-contained Byte-Pair-Encoding tokenizer: trains a merge table on a text corpus and tokenizes by replaying merges with a greedy longest-match fallback for rare words.
nodes.languageNotes: Single BPETokenizer class; training only uses non-whitespace words and preserves whitespace runs as their own tokens at tokenize-time.

nodes.name: BPETokenizer
nodes.summary: BPE subword tokenizer holding a character vocabulary and an ordered merge list; exposes train() to build the merge table and tokenize() to segment text into subword tokens.

nodes.name: train
nodes.summary: Iteratively finds the most frequent adjacent token pair above a frequency floor, merges it, and records it, building the ordered merge list until no pairs qualify or a maxMerges cap is hit.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Segments text into words and whitespace runs, replays the learned merges per word, and falls back to greedy longest-match against the known token set so rare words avoid single-character splits.

nodes.name: category_theory.html
nodes.summary: Standalone test page that renders a TikZJax commutative diagram (x -> f(x) -> (g o f)(x)) to verify the diagram toolchain used for category-theory content.

nodes.name: citation_graph.js
nodes.summary: Data file exposing window.citationGraph, a directed map from each literature.js citation key to the keys it builds on, encoding the intellectual lineage (foundations through modern LLMs) behind the book's bibliography.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure data: assigns one window.citationGraph object literal of key -> [ancestor keys]; grouped by era via comment headers.

nodes.name: cluster.js
nodes.summary: Implements 'Aurora Clusters': converts [[c:name]]...[[/c]] markers in lesson Markdown into softly-glowing color lanes, assigning each cluster name a stable hue (curated palette or golden-angle fallback) and injecting matching CSS variables.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.BlogClusters; registers a custom marked block extension so multi-paragraph cluster blocks get correct inner wrapping, and a MutationObserver re-injects CSS vars for late-loading modules.

nodes.name: preprocess
nodes.summary: Runs before marked.parse: registers the clusterBlock marked extension (once) and delegates to the balanced scanner to turn inline clusters into data-cluster spans.

nodes.name: findNextCluster
nodes.summary: Balanced scanner that walks the text to the next [[c:NAME]]/[[cluster:NAME]] open, then advances char-by-char matching nested opens to their closes and returns the name, inner text and span.

nodes.name: injectCSS
nodes.summary: Scans the DOM (and window.__blogClusters) for cluster names and writes a #blog-cluster-vars <style> block defining --cl-<name> base/glow/soft/mist/halo custom properties, skipping rework when the name set is unchanged.

nodes.name: getColor
nodes.summary: Resolves a cluster name to its hue (from the curated PALETTE or a deterministic golden-angle hash) and derives the full HSL palette (base, glow, soft, mist, three halos).

nodes.name: commutation.html
nodes.summary: A pre-rendered SVG of the same commutative diagram (x, f(x), (g o f)(x) with f, g o f, g arrows) used as a static asset alongside the TikZJax test page.

nodes.name: Corrections for coherent_world_models.php
nodes.summary: Content-audit of the coherent_world_models lesson cataloguing 9 mathematical/philosophical inconsistencies (object-vs-element G, fan-vs-chain cover structure, self-undermining 'coherence = descent', etc.) with a severity table; all items marked as applied.

nodes.name: darkmode_todo.txt
nodes.summary: Tracking note of dark-mode background fixes per lesson (white Plotly/ECharts canvases and light callout boxes), each marked FIXED, plus maintenance notes pointing to the CSS block and the global Plotly theme observer in helper.js.

nodes.name: effects.js
nodes.summary: Quiet visual enhancement: adds an 'effects-on' class to <html> and cascade-fades in each .course-part via IntersectionObserver as it scrolls into view, falling back to fully visible when the observer or reduced-motion is unavailable.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE; respects prefers-reduced-motion and no-JS (default visible state).

nodes.name: fcnn_visualization.js
nodes.summary: Canvas renderer for a full-network (Dense/Flatten/LayerNorm/Conv2D) architecture: reads the live TF.js model's layers, computes node/layer layout, and draws connected neurons with theme-aware colors and labels.
nodes.languageNotes: Global functions driven by a shared `model` (TF.js) handle; debounced restart via setTimeout, and uses themeColor()/isDarkMode() helpers for theming.

nodes.name: draw_fcnn
nodes.summary: Sizing and draw entry point: sizes the #fcnn_canvas from its container, computes node radius and layer spacing, and hands off to the low-level drawer.

nodes.name: restart_fcnn
nodes.summary: Debounced (100ms) redraw trigger that clears any pending timeout and re-renders the network once the canvas is visible.

nodes.name: get_fcnn_data
nodes.summary: Walks the TF.js model.layers, keeping only Dense/Flatten/LayerNorm/Conv2D layers, and returns parallel arrays of layer names, unit counts, and per-layer meta info for the drawer.

nodes.name: find_double_defined_js.sh
nodes.summary: Development shell script that greps every .js file for top-level 'function <name>' definitions and reports any name defined more than once in a file, exiting non-zero if duplicates are found.

nodes.name: functions.php
nodes.summary: The blog's central server-side infrastructure: parses every lesson's COURSE_METADATA block to auto-build the course drawer/index/progress, provides the asset and lesson loaders (js/css/incl), the post-load JS orchestrator, and renders the chrome (theme/topics/reader toggles, drawer, module nav, hero constellation).
nodes.languageNotes: Mix of PHP helpers and an inline <script> post-load orchestrator; scans *.php files via glob and parses COURSE_METADATA comments so lessons are discovered automatically. A mid-file output-buffering seam (the '}' at line ~694) closes the if(!index) HTML head/body block before the remaining helper functions are defined.

nodes.name: parse_course_metadata
nodes.summary: Core discovery routine: globs all *.php lessons, extracts each COURSE_METADATA comment, sorts by part then order, and returns modules grouped by part — the single source of truth for the drawer, index tiles and progress.

nodes.name: incl
nodes.summary: Includes a lesson section: loads its matching .js (passing the headline as the loader label), requires the .php file to exist, prints the <h1>, and includes the lesson body.

nodes.name: js
nodes.summary: De-duplicating script tag emitter: anchors local lookups to __DIR__, appends a ?v=filemtime cache buster, and for files defining load*Module() pushes the loader onto window.__moduleLoaderQueue with a cleaned label.

nodes.name: css
nodes.summary: Emits a stylesheet <link> with a ?v=filemtime cache buster for local files (or a raw link for URLs).

nodes.name: load_base_js
nodes.summary: Loads the full base asset bundle (Temml, bpe, echarts, prism, literature, citation_graph, jquery, plotly, tf, marked, helper, cluster, topics, search, keypoint, progress_tracker, and all modules/*.js) and prints the inline post-load coordination script.

nodes.name: print_font_override
nodes.summary: Prints a <head> font override: preloads the chosen serif (Lingua Franca or Computer Modern), publishes window.__blogFontSpecs for force-loading, and sets the --mn-font-* CSS variables site-wide.

nodes.name: render_gem_tabs
nodes.summary: Renders a CSS-only radio-button tab group (title => content panels) with a unique hash per group so multiple tab groups can coexist on one page, and injects a one-time copy-buttons script.

nodes.name: print_dynamic_title
nodes.summary: Reads the calling lesson's own COURSE_METADATA title and emits it into the requested tag (the <title> with LaTeX $ stripped, or the <h1>).

nodes.name: get_ai_course_labels
nodes.summary: Builds the \label{...} -> lesson-slug map by scanning every lesson's content, used to resolve in-page label targets for the course index.

nodes.name: render_course_tile
nodes.summary: Renders one course index tile as a link card with icon, title, description, accent color, and data-topics/data-tags/data-mathlevel attributes that drive the 3-state dimming in topics.js.

nodes.name: get_module_nav_data
nodes.summary: Flattens parse_course_metadata into the linear course order and returns it with the current lesson's index, powering the progress bar and next/prev navigation.

nodes.name: render_module_nav
nodes.summary: Renders the previous/next lesson navigation links for the current lesson based on get_module_nav_data.

nodes.name: render_drawer
nodes.summary: Renders the slide-out course drawer: a backdrop, a header with close button, and per-part sections listing every module, marking the current lesson active.

nodes.name: render_theme_toggle
nodes.summary: Renders the top-right dark/light toggle button (sun/moon SVGs) wired to toggleTheme().

nodes.name: render_topics_toggle
nodes.summary: Renders the 'pick your interests' target button that opens the topics overlay (wired up later by topics.js).

nodes.name: render_reader_toggle
nodes.summary: Renders the reader-mode book button (keyboard shortcut R) wired to toggleReaderMode(), a CSS-only focus mode persisted in localStorage.

nodes.name: render_constellation
nodes.summary: Emits the hero <canvas class="organic-network"> and loads organic-network.js to paint the drifting node/edge backdrop that self-fades on scroll.

nodes.name: runPostLoad
nodes.summary: Inline-JS orchestrator that runs exactly once after both modules and window load: extracts sidenotes, runs bibtexify + renderMarkdown, force-loads the page's font faces (4s capped), reveals content, and dispatches blogPostLoadComplete.

nodes.name: A Geometric and Topological Theory of Meaningful Language Spaces
nodes.summary: Long research-program essay proposing a geometric/topological account of language: a combinatorial possibility space X_N, multi-field 'void vectors' (syntactic/semantic/grounding/epistemic), cosmic-web cluster-filament-void structure, fractality, and a four-level program ending in open questions.

nodes.name: graph.php
nodes.summary: 'River of Ideas' interactive SVG timeline: a ~15-row-by-11-column vertical graph of ~120 AI-history milestones across 8 colored streams, with curved dependency edges, hover tooltips, 2-hop connectedness highlighting, a legend, era bands, and optional scroll-to-section highlighting.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained: inline <style> + <script> IIFE with hardcoded NODES and EDGES data arrays; draws glow + main path per edge, era bands and a right-side timeline, and re-renders on resize.

nodes.name: helper.js
nodes.summary: The core client-side runtime for the blog: handles Markdown rendering (with LaTeX/index protection), citation processing (\cite/\footcite), typography, lazy section initialization, optional block expansion, reading progress, and the global dark-mode theme observer.
nodes.languageNotes: Vanilla JS with significant global state via 'window'. Uses IntersectionObserver for lazy init and a MutationObserver for theme changes.

nodes.name: renderMarkdown
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the rendering of <div class="md"> containers, including restoring escaped characters, processing \index{} tags, running BlogClusters/BlogTopics preprocessing, and performing post-processing for captions, punctuation, and key-points.

nodes.name: bibtexify
nodes.summary: Parses LaTeX-style citation macros and footnotes in the DOM, resolving them using window.bibData, and constructing a linked bibliography section with stable IDs.

nodes.name: smartPunct
nodes.summary: Performs a typographic pass on text nodes to convert dashes, ellipses, and straight quotes into their proper typographic forms, avoiding code and math blocks.

nodes.name: bindIframeSafeLinks
nodes.summary: Attaches click handlers to citation links to ensure they resolve correctly to their targets (even with legacy ID drift) and trigger a cinematic sonar/glow highlight effect.

nodes.name: image.php
nodes.summary: A server-side PHP utility for intelligent image processing, handling cropping, aspect-ratio fitting, and resizing with robust error reporting and Debian-specific troubleshooting hints.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses custom error/exception handlers to ensure fatal errors return clean, actionable plain-text HTTP responses instead of empty 500s.

nodes.name: img_send
nodes.summary: Sends a standardized HTTP error response with a descriptive message and a troubleshooting hint, specifically designed for debugging server-side image failures.

nodes.name: img_parse_ratio
nodes.summary: Parses aspect-ratio query parameters from 'W:H' strings or decimal floats.

nodes.name: index_full.php
nodes.summary: The monolithic course view that renders the complete linear curriculum by including every lesson module in sequence.

nodes.name: index.php
nodes.summary: The primary landing page, featuring a course hero, introductory content, and a grid of interactive course tiles for each part.

nodes.name: init.js
nodes.summary: Provides global initialization logic for the client, such as triggering Markdown rendering on load and resizing Plotly charts on window resize.

nodes.name: From Big Bang to ChatGPT: Beyond the Black Box
nodes.summary: The course introduction lesson, providing high-level context, scope, and navigating the interactive philosophy of the curriculum.

nodes.name: js_syntax_test.sh
nodes.summary: A simple shell script for automated syntax validation of all JavaScript files in the project using `node -c`.

nodes.name: keypoint.js
nodes.summary: A utility that transforms standard Markdown blockquotes into visually distinct 'key-point' cards for important summaries or questions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a robust, defensive programming pattern with extensive input validation to ensure idempotency and prevent runtime errors during DOM manipulation.

nodes.name: upgradeBlockquotes
nodes.summary: Scans a container for blockquotes that meet specific length and content criteria, then converts them into styled .kp-block elements.

nodes.name: Knowledge Map
nodes.summary: A sophisticated interactive visualization that builds a weighted graph of the course based on shared citations, concept affinity (TF-IDF), and the course path.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines PHP-side graph calculation (concept scoring, edge weighting) with a heavy client-side ECharts-based interactive interface.

nodes.name: buildConceptGraph
nodes.summary: Computes the concept-based graph for the 'Universe' view, identifying high-centrality nodes and density-capped edges based on co-occurrence.

nodes.name: layer_commuting_diagram.html
nodes.summary: A static SVG representation of a commuting diagram used to visualize mathematical relationships between layers in a network.

nodes.name: layout_guardrail.js
nodes.summary: A diagnostic tool that detects and flags elements in the #contents column that exceed the allowed width, helping authors catch layout bugs.
nodes.languageNotes: Features a sophisticated measurement loop with built-in debouncing, support for 'reader mode' transitions, and a high-fidelity reporting banner with AI-fix generation.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Performs the primary layout measurement sweep, identifies offending elements, and updates the global guardrail state and UI banner.

nodes.name: literature.js
nodes.summary: Central bibliography store exposing `window.bibData`, a flat map of ~1,738 citation keys (title, author, year, url, alternativetitle) that `bibtexify()` in helper.js resolves at runtime for \cite/\citeauthor/\footcite macros used across every lesson's prose and figure captions.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure declarative data: assigns a single `window.bibData` object literal with no functions or classes; entries are grouped by lesson via comment headers, and every `url` is link-checked in CI (tests/link_checker.py).

nodes.name: literature.php
nodes.summary: Paginated literature reader that reads literature.js, parses each bibliography entry with a tolerant regex (no strict JSON), and renders a dark-themed table of title/author/year/link with a ?page= pagination control (10 per page).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses preg_match_all to scrape the flat window.bibData object literal from literature.js; escapes output with htmlspecialchars and clamps the page param to [1, totalPages].

nodes.name: manuallyParseBib
nodes.summary: Regex-parses the raw text of literature.js into an array of {title, author, year, url} entries keyed by citation id, tolerating both quoted and unquoted field values and BCE year forms.

nodes.name: llm_river.js
nodes.summary: ECharts 'Probability Flow' ThemeRiver for the transformer lesson: projects a chosen token's hidden state at every processing stage onto the vocab and visualizes the top-N word probabilities as flowing bands.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads window.tlab_trajectory_collector and window.persistentEmbeddingSpace, computes logits as h dot E^T then softmax per stage; registers via registerLazyRenderable and forces a re-render during training.

nodes.name: tlab_render_themeriver
nodes.summary: Entry point: guards on the trajectory collector, ensures the ThemeRiver wrapper DOM exists, populates the token-position selector, and registers the chart for lazy (viewport-triggered) rendering.

nodes.name: _execute_themeriver_render
nodes.summary: Core render: reads the token/top-N selections, collects per-stage probabilities, selects top words, assembles the flat river data, and sets the full ECharts option (replacing the chart when the word count changes).

nodes.name: _themeriver_collect_probs
nodes.summary: For a given token index, builds the vocab embedding matrix and, for each sorted collector step, computes the softmax probability over the vocabulary (logits = hidden dot E^T), returning {vocab, stages}.

nodes.name: _themeriver_build_option
nodes.summary: Assembles the full ECharts ThemeRiver option object: title/tooltip/legend, a 'value'-typed single axis with rotated stage-name labels at integer positions, and the themeRiver series with a color palette.

nodes.name: _themeriver_select_top_words
nodes.summary: Ranks vocabulary words by their maximum probability across all stages and returns the top-N words, the set of their indices, and whether an '(other)' aggregate band is needed.

nodes.name: forceRerenderVisibleThemeRiver
nodes.summary: If the ThemeRiver is already visible in the viewport but has not yet rendered (e.g. during live training when the observer will not re-fire), forces an immediate re-render.

nodes.name: loader.js
nodes.summary: Module-loading orchestrator: runs every loader in window.__moduleLoaderQueue concurrently (each yielding once so the browser can paint), updating a visible per-module checklist and status until all resolve.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps each loader in a Promise that awaits a setTimeout(0) to paint 'loading' before starting; sets _modulesLoaded and calls runPostLoad() on completion.

nodes.name: loader_fn
nodes.summary: Builds the loader checklist UI, force-paints it, then runs all module loaders concurrently via Promise.all (each yielding once before starting) and finalizes the checklist when done.

nodes.name: master_vis.js
nodes.summary: 2D linear-regression lab ('Master Viz Engine'): an editable (x, y) data table, weight/bias sliders, live MSE readout, residual and model-line plots, a 3D log-loss landscape, and a step-animated SGD/Adam optimizer.
nodes.languageNotes: Holds mutable masterState (data, weights, Adam m/v/t); uses Plotly.react for the 2D residual plot and 3D surface, and a 40 ms-throttled loop to animate weight updates.

nodes.name: initMasterLab
nodes.summary: Async bootstrap (wired to DOMContentLoaded): injects the dynamic control-panel HTML, renders the editable data table, and draws the initial plots.

nodes.name: updatePlots
nodes.summary: Redraws both Plotly views from masterState — the 2D data/residuals/model-line chart and the 3D log-loss landscape (surface + current-weight marker) — then refreshes the math readout.

nodes.name: startOptimizationAnimation
nodes.summary: Runs up to 100 gradient steps, computing the analytic MSE gradient and updating weights with either plain SGD or Adam (momentum/velocity with bias correction), re-plotting every 40 ms.

nodes.name: generateLossLandscape
nodes.summary: Builds a 25x25 grid of log(MSE) over (bias, weight) centered on the current bias, returning a Plotly surface trace plus a marker at the current weights.

nodes.name: calcCurrentLoss
nodes.summary: Computes the mean squared error of the linear model y = w1*x + b against the current data points, used for the live readout and the loss landscape.

nodes.name: generateResiduals
nodes.summary: Builds the 2D Plotly traces: data markers, a red dashed residual segment with a labeled delta per point, and the fitted model line.

nodes.name: math_deri.html
nodes.summary: Standalone interactive 'Understanding Derivatives' guide built on Plotly: self-contained sections (tangent/limit, power rule, constant/sum/product/quotient/chain, trig, etc.) each with a slider and a live plot.
nodes.languageNotes: Single self-contained HTML page loading Plotly from CDN; each section has its own inline <script> with getTraces/initPlot/updatePlot helpers wired to a range input.

nodes.name: math_iii_hott.js
nodes.summary: Interactive Homotopy Type Theory lab woven into the 'Type Theory and HoTT' lesson: ten canvas/Three.js/Plotly components covering the black-box problem, type-checking/Curry-Howard, homotopy, identity types, the tower of equalities, verification, uncertainty, ontologies, a Bloch-sphere qubit, and XAI decision paths.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE with a redraws/lazyInits registry so WebGL/Plotly init lazily on first expansion of the optional box and everything repaints on a theme flip; math rendered via the blog's temml engine.

nodes.name: initHottLab
nodes.summary: Idempotent bootstrap (fired on blogPostLoadComplete or load): finds the lab wrapper, builds all ten components, sets up lazy WebGL/Plotly init via a ResizeObserver, and hooks theme changes to repaint.

nodes.name: buildMotivation
nodes.summary: Component 0: an animated 2D canvas cycling three core AI problems (unexplainable black box, adversarial panda->gibbon, untested infinite input space) with step buttons.

nodes.name: buildTypes
nodes.summary: Component 1: an interactive type checker (value -> function type, pass/fail) and a Curry-Howard slider mapping logic connectives (and/or/implication/forall) to product/sum/function/dependent-product types.

nodes.name: buildHomotopy
nodes.summary: Component 2: animates deforming one path toward another (with intermediate H(t) ribbons) and a second canvas where a deformation around a hole collides, illustrating when homotopy is impossible.

nodes.name: buildIdentity
nodes.summary: Component 3: shows identity types as a family of paths between a and b (a configurable count), with an animated token traveling along each path and the corresponding Id_A(a,b) math.

nodes.name: buildHigher
nodes.summary: Component 4: a Three.js 'tower of equalities' — paths (1D), 2D surfaces between paths, and a 3D volume between surfaces — with a dimension slider and drag/auto-rotate.

nodes.name: buildVerify
nodes.summary: Component 5: three formal-verification scenarios from the paper (differential privacy, loan fairness, adversarial robustness), each with a scenario diagram and its HoTT identity-type statement.

nodes.name: buildUncertainty
nodes.summary: Component 6: a Bayesian diagnosis bar chart (symptoms/tests -> disease posteriors) and a canvas of a meta-uncertainty distribution showing 2nd-order (HoTT) uncertainty vs. 1st-order Bayes expectation.

nodes.name: buildKnowledge
nodes.summary: Component 7: an ontology graph (diseases/symptoms/treatments from multiple sources) that draws dashed HoTT identity paths between alias entities as sources are added.

nodes.name: buildQuantum
nodes.summary: Component 8: a Three.js qubit on the Bloch sphere with theta/phi sliders, the |psi> state, a measure button, and the state vector rendered as math.

nodes.name: buildXai
nodes.summary: Component 9: an explainable-AI decision-path explorer — click the input space to trace a path through a small network to an output class, with optional path-equivalence links between same-class inputs.

nodes.name: math_iv_affine.js
nodes.summary: Affine, space-folding, and Hopf interactive labs for the Math IV lesson: a DOM-free pure-math core (matrices, folds, Hopf tubes, Gauss linking number) plus five canvas labs — 2D/3D affine warp, the 2D fold with a 3D bent-paper view, a radial/ReLU 'circle in a circle' classifier, and a Hopf link unlinked by a fold.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE; exposes a DOM-free math core on window.__affineMath (Mat, Fold, Hopf, cbBilinear, buildCubeQuads, gaussLink, ...); batched RAF scheduler and a theme-redraw registry; exposes window.loadMathIVModule for the PHP loader hook.

nodes.name: init2D
nodes.summary: Lab 2D: an 8x8 checkerboard warped by an editable 3x3 homogeneous matrix, with a fast inverse-warp renderer (precomputed row-step), presets, hover preimage tracing, and live matrix/point equations.

nodes.name: init3D
nodes.summary: Lab 3D: a 4x4 homogeneous matrix warping a checkerboard cube, with orthographic/perspective camera, painter's-algorithm quad sorting, draggable/auto rotation, corner tracking, and area/volume/determinant status.

nodes.name: initF2
nodes.summary: Lab F2 (the fold): a 2D piecewise-affine fold (ReLU of a signed distance to a crease) with a 3D bent-paper view, screen-to-paper raycasting, preimage counting on hover, a 1D fold curve, and step-by-step equations.

nodes.name: initA2
nodes.summary: Lab A2 (circle in a circle): a two-class concentric point cloud mapped by a radial ReLU/tanh fold, showing a 3D embedding where a flat cut separates the classes, with a 1D activation profile and separability readout.

nodes.name: initU3
nodes.summary: Lab U3 (Hopf link unlinked by a fold): renders two Hopf-link tubes deformed by a 3D fold, computes the Gauss linking number live, and shows a separation animation plus linked/mid-fold/unlinked status.

nodes.name: bootAll
nodes.summary: Bootstrap entry point that initializes all five labs (init2D/3D/F2/A2/U3), each wrapped in its own try/catch so one lab failing does not block the others.

nodes.name: gaussLink
nodes.summary: Computes the Gauss linking number between two closed polygonal curves via a tight, allocation-free double loop over the 1/(4pi) integral of (p-q).(dp x dq)/|p-q|^3.

nodes.name: buildCubeQuads
nodes.summary: Precomputes the KxK checkerboard quads for all six cube faces (each with its 0/1 check value and face index), built once and reused by the 3D affine-warp lab.

nodes.name: cbBilinear
nodes.summary: Bilinear sampler for the 8x8 checkerboard: returns a smooth 0..1 interpolated value at (u, v), used for the anti-aliased (vs. nearest-neighbor) warp option.

nodes.name: mobile-loader.php
nodes.summary: Small includable that emits a <link> to mobile.css (before </head>) and a deferred <script> to mobile.js, both with ?v=filemtime cache-busters; intended for index.php / index_full.php.
nodes.languageNotes: No functions; computes filemtime-based query strings and prints the two tags. On auto-rendered pages mobile.js self-injects mobile.css as a fallback.

nodes.name: mobile-prepend.php
nodes.summary: Registered via .user.ini's auto_prepend_file to run at the top of every PHP script: starts output buffering and, when the buffer contains </head>, injects cache-busted <link>/<script> tags for mobile.css and mobile.js (skipping pages that already load them or are tiny/CLI).
nodes.languageNotes: Single IIFE using ob_start() with a callback that regex-injects the asset tags just before </head>; guards against CLI SAPI and double-registration via a MOBILE_PREPEND_ACTIVE constant.

nodes.name: mobile.css
nodes.summary: Mobile/responsive polish CSS layer loaded after style.css: mobile-first hygiene, plus tablet (<=900px), phone (<=600px), small-phone (<=380px), touch-only (hover:none), landscape, and reduced-motion rules, scoped so they never leak into the chrome.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of env(safe-area-inset-*), 100dvh via @supports, clamp() typography, and touch/hover media queries; references classes from style.css (cl-block, course-tile, etc.) to override on small screens.

nodes.name: mobile.js
nodes.summary: Mobile/responsive JS polish loaded after start.js: injects mobile.css as a fallback, adds touch-only glossary tap-tooltips and drawer swipe-to-close, fixes the iOS viewport height and input auto-zoom, and broadcasts resize so Plotly charts re-fit.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE; every feature is defensive (no-ops if the target or API is absent); re-runs boot on DOMContentLoaded and load, and defers syncVH/syncSafeArea/broadcastResize through requestAnimationFrame on resize/orientationchange.

nodes.name: ensureMobileCSS
nodes.summary: If no <link> for mobile.css is already present (auto-render pages that couldn't add one), injects it into the head so the styles still apply.

nodes.name: initGlossaryTapToggle
nodes.summary: On touch devices, wires a document-level click handler so tapping a .glossary-term opens (clamped to the viewport) its tooltip and tapping elsewhere dismisses it, only one term open at a time.

nodes.name: initDrawerSwipe
nodes.summary: Adds swipe-to-close to the drawer panel: tracks touchstart/move/end, follows the drag with a transform, and commits the close (via the close button) once the horizontal drag exceeds a threshold.

nodes.name: syncVH
nodes.summary: Sets the --vh CSS custom property to 1% of window.innerHeight so 100vh-based fallbacks track the iOS address-bar collapse.

nodes.name: broadcastResize
nodes.summary: Dispatches a 'mobile:resize' custom event and, if Plotly is present, resizes all .js-plotly-plot instances so charts re-fit on rotation/resize.

nodes.name: boot
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the mobile polish on load: runs ensureMobileCSS, the glossary/drawer touch handlers, syncVH/syncSafeArea/lockInputZoom, and registers rAF-throttled resize/orientation listeners.

nodes.name: organic-network.js
nodes.summary: Decorative slow-drifting node-and-link network rendered behind the course hero: seeded once, structure-preserving across resizes, dt-clamped so motion stays continuous, and it keeps ticking (but skips painting) when scrolled off-screen.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained IIFE that no-ops without a .course-hero .organic-network canvas; theme-aware stroke color, prefers-reduced-motion renders a single static frame, and a per-frame rect poll drives sizing.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Idempotent entry point: grabs the hero element and either starts the requestAnimationFrame loop (normal) or, for reduced-motion users, renders a single static frame plus resize/load re-renders.

nodes.name: frame
nodes.summary: Per-tick loop: measures the hero rect, applies sizing, toggles the is-scrolled-past fade class, advances the dt-clamped simulation, and paints only while the hero is at least partly on screen.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Advances each node by a dt-scaled drift with a sinusoidal wobble and reflects it softly off the hero edges so the constellation stays inside the parent box.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Paints the current frame: distance-faded edges between nearby nodes, then pulsing nodes on top, using the theme-aware color composed per-pixel with alpha.

nodes.name: rescaleNodes
nodes.summary: Structure-preserving resize: proportionally rescales existing node positions to the new hero size and tops up / trims the node count to the area-based target without re-randomizing.

nodes.name: renderStatic
nodes.summary: Reduced-motion path: measures the hero and paints a single static frame (re-painted on resize/load/content-load) instead of running the animation loop.

nodes.name: php_syntax_check.sh
nodes.summary: Developer shell script that recursively runs php -l over every .php file and reports any that fail, exiting non-zero if syntax errors are found.

nodes.name: polish.js
nodes.summary: Reading-polish layer that makes long technical prose pleasant: per-heading anchor links, TOC scroll-spy, keyboard shortcuts, code copy buttons, footnote/citation hover previews, an image lightbox, back-to-top, drop-cap sizing, equation/caption numbering, and acronym small-caps.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE; a structural run() pass plus a MutationObserver that re-runs it 80 ms after late content swaps (MathJax/modules), with guard-rails so tooltip re-parenting never re-measures the drop cap.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Bootstrap (DOMContentLoaded or immediately): runs the structural pass and installs the TOC scroll-spy, shortcuts, reading meta, back-to-top, and image lightbox, plus a MutationObserver and H1 poll for late content.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: The structural DOM pass: drop-cap marking, heading anchors (+copy upgrade), code-block language labels, copy buttons, footnote/citation previews, caption numbering, equation wrapping, and acronym marking, then defers to TypographyFix.

nodes.name: installHeadingAnchors
nodes.summary: Gives every .md heading a slug id and a hover-visible '#' anchor that smooth-scrolls and updates the URL hash on click.

nodes.name: installTocScrollSpy
nodes.summary: Highlights the TOC item for the section currently in view using an IntersectionObserver, scrolling the active item into view as needed.

nodes.name: installShortcuts
nodes.summary: Binds keyboard shortcuts (inactive while typing): '/' focus search, '?' help, Esc close, g g / G top/bottom, 1-9 jump to Nth TOC item, n/p next/prev section.

nodes.name: installImageLightbox
nodes.summary: Click-to-zoom image lightbox: builds a dialog with prev/next/close, gathers the gallery across #contents and the margin rails, locks page scroll, and handles keyboard arrows — all via capture-phase delegated clicks.

nodes.name: installFootnotePreview
nodes.summary: Adds a hover tooltip to each footnote-ref superscript showing the footnote text, portaled to <body> and positioned fixed from the anchor's rect.

nodes.name: installCitationPreview
nodes.summary: Adds a hover tooltip to bibliography links (data-target=bib-*) showing the formatted citation, cloned from the bibliography entry and portaled to <body>.

nodes.name: installReadingMeta
nodes.summary: Computes word count and an estimated reading time (~220 wpm) over the article and stamps data-words / data-reading-time on the H1 and document for CSS display.

nodes.name: installCopyButtons
nodes.summary: Adds a hover 'copy' button to every code block that copies to the clipboard (with a textarea/execCommand fallback) and briefly shows 'copied'.

nodes.name: installBackToTop
nodes.summary: Adds a back-to-top chevron that appears only after ~60% scroll and smooth-scrolls to the top on click, throttled through requestAnimationFrame.

nodes.name: markDropcapParagraph
nodes.summary: Finds the article's opening paragraph and tags it .cl-dropcap, then sizes the drop cap; idempotent (skips when the measurement key is unchanged) and re-measures on the 700px breakpoint via matchMedia.

nodes.name: numberEquations
nodes.summary: Wraps display math in a .cl-eq span so a right-margin CSS counter can number it, opting equations out when they sit before the first h2.

nodes.name: markAcronyms
nodes.summary: Walks the text nodes and wraps a curated set of all-caps acronyms (AI, LLM, GPT, CNN, ...) in a .caps span for small-caps rendering, skipping code/math and already-marked text.

nodes.name: polyhedral-inconsistencies.md
nodes.summary: Working research note (not a lesson) cataloguing tensions in the polyhedral / ReLU 'space-folding' literature — exponential region bounds vs. realized geometry, features-as-directions vs. the polytope lens, disentangled vs. folded representations, direction-sensitivity, and a feedforward/reservoir parallel — each with the papers involved and reconciliation status.

nodes.name: prism-tomorrow.min.css
nodes.summary: Minified PrismJS 'Tomorrow' syntax-highlighting theme (single-line vendor CSS) providing token colors for code blocks.

nodes.name: progress_tracker.js
nodes.summary: Course-progress tracker that paints a segmented 'where I've been' bar on each homepage course tile and, on subpages, marks a 200px scroll band as 'seen' only after 3 s of dwell; state (with band arrays) is persisted to localStorage and old formats are auto-migrated.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.CourseProgress (reset/get); dwell pauses while the tab is hidden, saves are debounced, and the active band's partial dwell is carried into the percentage.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Entry point: loads state, logs a devtools reset hint, then either renders bars on all homepage course tiles or starts scroll/dwell tracking for the current subpage slug.

nodes.name: trackSubpage
nodes.summary: Core subpage tracking: divides the scrollable page into 200px bands and, as the user dwells 3 s in the active band, marks it seen, recomputes the percentage, and debounced-saves; pauses dwell when the tab is hidden.

nodes.name: renderTile
nodes.summary: Paints a course tile's 10-segment progress bar (each segment's fill proportional to that band's dwell) and its hover percentage tip, flagging the tile as visited when fully filled.

nodes.name: normalizeTile
nodes.summary: Normalizes a stored tile record to the current shape, deriving maxScrollPct from a band array, a legacy raw percentage, or an older boolean segments array.

nodes.name: loadState
nodes.summary: Loads and normalizes the course_progress state from localStorage, tolerating disabled storage or corrupt JSON by keeping the default state.

nodes.name: saveState
nodes.summary: Debounced (300 ms) write of the current state to localStorage, updating updatedAt and swallowing quota/private-mode errors.

nodes.name: ensureBands
nodes.summary: Resizes the per-tile band array to the current band count, preserving existing dwell and, when migrating from a legacy percentage, distributing it proportionally into the new bands.

nodes.name: dwellTick
nodes.summary: 250 ms interval that accrues dwell into the active band (dt-clamped, paused while hidden) until it reaches 3 s, then recomputes the max and schedules a save.

nodes.name: provenance.js
nodes.summary: Instruments the Transformer lesson so every rendered number can be hovered to reveal its full computation: a value-matched registry of intermediate matrices, a tooltip with underbraced formulas, and a 'light cone' / importance / full-network dependency view.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.Prov; a central grid registry keyed by stable ids (L:1:norm, F:logit) that is value-matched against the Temml-rendered <math> DOM and lazily materializes dependency nodes via cached S._mat.

nodes.name: recordPre
nodes.summary: Records the initial hidden states (embedding, positional encoding, h0) for the given tokens into the provenance registry, namespaced by a 'P'/'R:0' pass prefix.

nodes.name: recordLayer
nodes.summary: Records the attention sublayer of one transformer layer — layer-norm, QKV projections, per-head scores/weights/context, output projection and residual — into the registry.

nodes.name: recordFfn
nodes.summary: Records the feed-forward sublayer of a layer (second norm, W1/W2, biases, GELU intermediate and output) into the provenance registry.

nodes.name: recordFinal
nodes.summary: Records the final stage (unembedding logits, original/temperature-scaled probabilities, entropy, final tokens) and sets the final-stage metadata used by the provenance views.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Walks a Temml-rendered container and value-matches each <mtd> cell against the registry, stamping it with data-prov-id and the prov-cell class so it becomes hoverable.

nodes.name: fullTrace
nodes.summary: BFS-walks the dependency graph from a value back to its input leaves, returning the capped, depth-ordered chain of contributing nodes.

nodes.name: derivation
nodes.summary: Uncapped backward closure of one value returned in reading order (leaves first, value last) to render 'every formula from token embedding to the current point'.

nodes.name: importance
nodes.summary: Async-sliced ranking of the full provenance: impact flows backward weighted by each term's share of its parent's magnitude plus a spatial/temporal bias, driving the 'light cone' view.

nodes.name: netGraph
nodes.summary: Materializes the entire forward pass as a single dependency DAG by walking input edges from every final output, once per node.

nodes.name: show
nodes.summary: Opens (and positions) the provenance tooltip for a given node id, capturing the anchor and rendering the current view.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Entry point that injects the provenance tooltip styles and binds the document-level mouse/click/keydown listeners that drive hover-to-reveal behavior.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Course front-page describing 'From Big Bang to ChatGPT': its six parts, interactive/local/math-first approach, tech stack (PHP + vanilla JS, TeXmacs/Temml, Plotly, TensorFlow.js), and credit/license.

nodes.name: research_science_history.md
nodes.summary: Authoring research notes tracing how the mental and physical landscape (mythos, Scientific Revolution, Enlightenment) made LLMs possible; raw structured source material for the history lesson, organized around 'LLM hooks'.

nodes.name: search_lib.php
nodes.summary: Pure-function search engine core: indexes the blog's PHP lessons into blocks (headings, paragraphs, captions), normalizes text (smart quotes, diacritics, Greek, LaTeX, citations), and matches queries in normal, regex, and fuzzy modes with scoring and snippets.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure functions, no output; buildIndex caches a fingerprinted index in .search_cache.json and resolves citation macros against literature.js.

nodes.name: runSearch
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point: detects the query mode, builds/loads the index, runs searchIndex, and returns a structured JSON result set (results, grouped, total, mode, optional error).

nodes.name: buildIndex
nodes.summary: Builds (and caches) the search index for a directory of PHP pages, fingerprinting file mtimes and loading literature data, returning per-page cleaned blocks.

nodes.name: extractBlocks
nodes.summary: Extracts searchable blocks (headings, paragraphs, figure captions) from a page's raw PHP source, stripping scripts/styles and Markdown, with byte-offset positions and slugs.

nodes.name: searchIndex
nodes.summary: Runs a query against the built index across all pages/blocks, applies coverage rules, scores and sorts hits, and returns both the flat result list and per-page grouped results.

nodes.name: detectSearchMode
nodes.summary: Classifies a query as regex (wrapped in /.../), fuzzy (~prefix) or normal, validating/compiling the regex and returning a mode descriptor with any error.

nodes.name: blockMatch
nodes.summary: Matches a single block against the query in normal, regex, or fuzzy mode, returning position/count/quality match info or false.

nodes.name: matchQuery
nodes.summary: Scores a normalized text against a normalized multi-term query using word-boundary/prefix/substring token hits plus phrase and occurrence signals.

nodes.name: findBestFuzzyWord
nodes.summary: Finds the best fuzzy word match (exact, prefix, or bounded Levenshtein distance) in folded text, returning position and quality for fuzzy search.

nodes.name: renderLatex
nodes.summary: Flattens inline LaTeX to plain text for searchability, converting commands, sub/superscripts, and Greek/symbol macros to Unicode equivalents.

nodes.name: cleanText
nodes.summary: Pipeline that turns raw block markup into searchable plain text by cleaning math, markdown, and resolving citation macros against the bibliography.

nodes.name: loadLiterature
nodes.summary: Parses literature.js with regex into an in-memory bibliography (title/author/year/url/alternativetitle) used to resolve citation macros during indexing.

nodes.name: makeSnippet
nodes.summary: Builds a ~200-char search snippet centered on the match, preferring a containing paragraph and adding ellipses where it is truncated.

nodes.name: search_excludes
nodes.summary: Returns the list of non-lesson PHP files (index, functions, search infra, etc.) that the search indexer must skip.

nodes.name: search.js
nodes.summary: Client-side search overlay (Ctrl/Cmd+K, '/' key): debounced fetch to search.php, grouped result rendering with term highlighting, keyboard navigation, and hash-based in-page heading scroll.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.initSearch; mirrors detectSearchMode from search_lib.php for the live mode hint and uses AbortController to cancel in-flight requests.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Builds the search overlay/modal DOM, wires the trigger, input, and global keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+K, '/', Esc) for the search interface.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Opens the search overlay (initializing it if needed) and focuses/selects the input, guarding against opening before the page loader has finished.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the search overlay, restores body scroll, and aborts any in-flight request and pending debounce.

nodes.name: doSearch
nodes.summary: Performs the debounced fetch to search.php?q=..., aborting the previous request, then renders results or an error from the JSON response.

nodes.name: renderResults
nodes.summary: Renders the search results grouped under each page with match highlighting, thumbnails, and per-result navigation handlers.

nodes.name: navigateToResult
nodes.summary: Navigates to a result, handling in-page hash targets (smooth scroll + flash) for the current page or a full page load for other lessons.

nodes.name: highlightText
nodes.summary: Highlights each query term (or the full regex match) in a snippet with <mark>, choosing a mode-specific CSS class.

nodes.name: findHeadingBySlug
nodes.summary: Resolves a URL hash to a heading element by id or by slugifying heading text, used to scroll to and flash the matched section.

nodes.name: search.php
nodes.summary: Thin JSON endpoint for the blog search: reads the ?q= query, runs runSearch over the local directory, and returns the result set as JSON with noindex headers.

nodes.name: sidenotes.js
nodes.summary: Tufte-style margin annotations and sticky side figures: extracts \sidenote/\sideimage/\marginfig directives, threads their content through the main LaTeX/Markdown pipeline, and positions/visibly-toggles them in a margin rail with a wrap fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.BlogSidenotes; heavy defensive 'guard rail' checks, IntersectionObserver-driven visibility, and a hysteresis band to prevent rail/wrap mode flip-flopping.

nodes.name: extract
nodes.summary: Preprocess step (runs before bibtexify/renderMarkdown): parses balanced \sidenote/\sideimage/\marginfig directives and stashes their raw content in hidden source containers so the main pipeline renders them.

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: Postprocess step (runs after bibtexify/renderMarkdown): copies the rendered HTML out of the hidden source containers into the actual margin note/figure elements.

nodes.name: layout
nodes.summary: Positions margin notes/figures in the rail, toggles their visibility per marker, and switches side figures into article-flow wrap mode when the margin is too narrow.

nodes.name: diagnose
nodes.summary: Emits a detailed multi-rail diagnostic report (containers, visibility consistency, geometry) to the console for debugging the sidenote pipeline.

nodes.name: start.js
nodes.summary: Site-wide bootstrapping and runtime infrastructure for the blog: LaTeX (Temml) math rendering with a right-click source popup, dark-mode toggling, theme-adaptive restyling of inline demo styles, the mobile drawer, module prev/next navigation, the auto-glossary tooltip system with layout guardrails, and a loader checklist.
nodes.languageNotes: Large IIFE-free global script; render_temml() does one-time popup bootstrap then a per-pass render; initGlossary uses a portal-to-body tooltip plus prototype/observer guardrails to keep hover layout-neutral.

nodes.name: render_temml
nodes.summary: Core math-rendering pass: fixes em/strong artifacts inside $...$ delimiters, hands off to Temml, defers offscreen elements to an IntersectionObserver, and bootstraps the one-time LaTeX-source popup (copy, scroll, keyboard, live-swap) on first call.

nodes.name: postLoadInit
nodes.summary: Shared post-load orchestrator called by index.php and standalone subpages; invokes smartquote, optional blocks, TOC, reading progress, easter eggs, dark mode, drawer, module nav, and glossary in sequence.

nodes.name: initGlossary
nodes.summary: Auto-detects GLOSSARY terms in prose via a word-boundary regex tree-walk, wraps them in .glossary-term spans with portaled body tooltips, and enforces multi-angle guardrails (title-stripping, ancestor-style reverter, metric canaries) so hover never shifts layout.

nodes.name: initDarkMode
nodes.summary: Wires the theme-toggle button, applies a persisted/system-preference theme on load with a transition class, and triggers theme adaptation of the interactive labs.

nodes.name: adaptLabsToTheme
nodes.summary: Rewrites hardcoded inline background/color styles, Plotly SVG backgrounds, canvas backgrounds, and Temml math colors so interactive demos stay readable in dark mode; guards against re-running on every DOM mutation.

nodes.name: initModuleNav
nodes.summary: Builds a prev/next module navigation bar from window.__moduleNavData and appends it to #contents, using the current lesson's position in the linear course order.

nodes.name: updateLoadingStatus
nodes.summary: Updates the loader status line (or a secondary sub-status detail line once the checklist exists) with progress messages emitted by loading submodules.

nodes.name: observeAndRenderMath
nodes.summary: Installs a MutationObserver on a target node that clears the data-math-rendered marker when its content changes and re-runs the Temml render pass.

nodes.name: initDrawer
nodes.summary: Sets up the mobile navigation drawer: open/close via toggle, backdrop, and Escape key, and closes on module link click.

nodes.name: sendHeight
nodes.summary: Computes the page's full scroll height and posts it to the parent window via postMessage so an embedding iframe can size the content.

nodes.name: statistics.js
nodes.summary: Interactive visualization module for the statistics lessons: a unified Plotly theme plus a large suite of hands-on labs (distributions, normal/CLT, least squares, correlation, Bayesian updating, entropy, Markov chains, Zipf/LLN over a Nietzsche corpus, Dirichlet, GMM, and LLM-related Boltzmann/MLE/chain-rule/KL) that render on demand via lazy IntersectionObserver registration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a shared getStatTheme()/mergeLayout() Plotly base; labs are registered lazily by element id in loadStatisticsModule and re-rendered on dark/light toggle via window.__MN_DARK.onChange.

nodes.name: loadStatisticsModule
nodes.summary: Module entry point: reports a loading status, lazily registers each lab by its target element id, starts the IntersectionObserver, and subscribes to theme changes to re-render initialized plots.

nodes.name: initStatistics
nodes.summary: Legacy eager initializer that awaits ZarathustraLab.init() and then renders all statistics labs in parallel with Promise.all.

nodes.name: getStatTheme
nodes.summary: Returns a fresh base Plotly layout (fonts, transparent backgrounds, indigo-pink colorway, themed axes/title/hover/legend) that all statistics labs merge their custom options into.

nodes.name: ZarathustraLab
nodes.summary: Namespace object that fetches zarathustra.txt and powers the corpus-based labs: Law of Large Numbers word-frequency convergence, Markov next-word transition probabilities, and Zipf's-law rank-frequency (with a log-log toggle).

nodes.name: LLMStatsLab
nodes.summary: Namespace object of LLM-related probability labs: Boltzmann/softmax temperature, Maximum Likelihood Estimation (click-to-add-observations Gaussian fit), the probability chain rule, and KL divergence between two Gaussians.

nodes.name: renderNormalDistribution
nodes.summary: Renders a live normal-distribution lab: a Box-Muller sample histogram against the theoretical PDF, with mu/sigma/points sliders that re-plot and refresh the LaTeX formula.

nodes.name: renderCeresAstronomy
nodes.summary: Plots the Ceres-orbit story: a true orbit path, noisy Gaussian observations, and a residual-error histogram vs. the theoretical bell curve, driven by a telescope-quality (sigma) slider.

nodes.name: renderGaussLegendreComplex
nodes.summary: Interactive least-squares fit: generates noisy points, computes the slope/intercept analytically, draws the fit plus per-point error squares, and displays the minimized squared-error expression.

nodes.name: renderCorrelationPlayground
nodes.summary: Pearson correlation playground: generates a correlated bivariate sample from correlation/scale sliders, scatters it, and walks through the covariance-to-r standardization step by step.

nodes.name: renderBayesianComplex
nodes.summary: Bayesian-updating lab (spam-filter style): given prior, likelihood, and false-alarm sliders it computes the posterior and plots prior-vs-posterior belief bars with the Bayes-rule derivation.

nodes.name: renderEntropy
nodes.summary: Shannon-entropy lab: two complementary coin sliders compute H(X) in bits, render the derivation, and plot the head/tail probability bars.

nodes.name: rollCLT
nodes.summary: Central Limit Theorem dice lab: rolls n dice, animates the dice, accumulates the average of each roll, and plots the observed-average histogram against the theoretical Gaussian.

nodes.name: renderDirichletLab
nodes.summary: Dirichlet-distribution lab: samples the 3-simplex (topic mixture) for three alpha parameters and renders a ternary scatter of likely topic proportions.

nodes.name: renderGMMContextLab
nodes.summary: Gaussian Mixture Model lab: plots two topic Gaussians and their mixture as a function of cluster separation and variance, illustrating latent-topic inference.

nodes.name: renderStandardScaler
nodes.summary: Z-score standardization lab: given observation/mean/sigma it computes the z-score and shows the derivation plus a plain-English outlier interpretation.

nodes.name: renderGaussCalc
nodes.summary: Normal-distribution calculator: standardizes a [a,b] range to z-scores, looks up the CDF, and shades the area under the curve to show P(a<=X<=b).

nodes.name: renderPoissonLab
nodes.summary: Poisson-distribution lab: plots P(X=k) for a rate lambda slider, using a local factorial helper for the rare-events law.

nodes.name: renderExtremeLab
nodes.summary: Extreme-value lab bundling a Bernoulli-trial bar chart and a Gumbel PDF plot, both driven by sliders, for the disasters/maxima section.

nodes.name: trainMarkovModel
nodes.summary: Builds a first-order Markov transition table from the user-editable markov-corpus textarea by counting word→next-word pairs.

nodes.name: statistics.php
nodes.summary: Consolidated 'statistics' reference lesson (prose + interactive labs) covering distributions, the normal distribution and least squares, Bayesian inference, entropy, correlation, Zipf/Dirichlet/GMM, and LLM probability labs; kept as a complete reference now split into statistics_i.php / statistics_ii.php.
nodes.languageNotes: Line 1 includes functions.php; body is Markdown in div.md blocks interleaved with .statlab-interactive-zone widgets (sliders + plot divs) and \\cite* citation macros.

nodes.name: stickybar_transformer.js
nodes.summary: Unified sticky bottom bar for the transformer lesson: shown while the transformer site is in view, it switches between an idle 'Start Training' panel and a live training panel (epoch, loss, ETA, mini loss sparkline) and exposes window.show/update/hideTrainingProgressBar plus a synced train-button state.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained IIFE; lazily builds the bar DOM, observes #transformer_site with IntersectionObserver, and monkey-patches window.updateTrainButtonState to keep its button in sync.

nodes.name: createStickyBar
nodes.summary: Builds the sticky bar element once (root styles plus idle and training panels), appends it to <body>, and wires the train/stop buttons and hover effects.

nodes.name: showTrainingProgressBar
nodes.summary: Public API: ensures the bar exists, records the training start time, syncs panel mode, and shows the bar if the site is visible.

nodes.name: updateTrainingProgressBar
nodes.summary: Public API: updates the progress fill/percent, epoch label, loss label, and an ETA guesstimate from elapsed time, and redraws the mini loss sparkline each epoch.

nodes.name: drawMiniLossChart
nodes.summary: Draws a small filled area + line sparkline of window.lossHistory on the bar's mini canvas, auto-scaled to the min/max loss.

nodes.name: initSiteObserver
nodes.summary: Observes #transformer_site with an IntersectionObserver to show/sync the bar while the transformer site is in the viewport and hide it otherwise.

nodes.name: story.html
nodes.summary: Standalone, self-contained animated explainer ('Was passiert da eigentlich?') that choreographs a sequence of CSS/JS beats: a phone search query is spoken, tokenized into pills, mapped to points in a 2-D embedding space (with a king/queen analogy), then handed off to a Transformer model block.
nodes.languageNotes: Single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS + JS; a 'beats' array of state-setting functions plus keyboard/swipe/click navigation (each beat fully re-sets state so CSS can interpolate forward and backward).

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: The blog's single global stylesheet: defines the design system via --mn-* custom properties (cream-paper light palette with a full dark-mode override, five surface/border steps, walnut text ramp, spacing ladder, --mn-col-width, and accent colors coral/rose/emerald/sky/indigo), self-hosted @font-face faces (Source Serif 4, Computer Modern 'CMS'/'CMSS', Utopia-derivative 'Lingua Franca'), and all component styles for the course shell and lesson widgets — typography with drop caps and Butterick rules, Tufte-style sidenotes and margin figures, callouts/code blocks, aurora color clusters, search overlay, theme toggle, module nav, mobile drawer, glossary tooltips, topic-block dim/collapse states, course-progress tiles, plus ~1,000 dark-mode inline-style rescue rules for lab pages and a final guardrail block locking drop-cap layout and word-breaking.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS custom-property design tokens (992 --mn-* occurrences) as the single source of truth; html.dark re-declares the token set for dark mode; attribute-selector overrides ([style*="..."]) patch inline-styled lab content rather than editing each lab; guardrail blocks are deliberately placed at the very end of the file to win the cascade.

nodes.name: tda_live.js
nodes.summary: TDALive — a live topological data analysis panel for the blog transformer. It runs the residual stream through the network, projects token states and weight trajectories (PCA/slice/native) to 2D/3D, computes a flow vector field with divergence-based attractor/repeller detection, streamlines and basins of attraction, persistent homology (H0/H1, Betti curves), and per-layer topology, rendering everything as a set of Plotly panels fed by an AttentionEngine onForward hook and per-epoch snapshots.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.TDALive {beginSession,endSession,captureEpoch,isActive,reset,recompute}; renders are signature-cached (frameSig/vfSig) and throttled (requestAnimationFrame + IntersectionObserver + a 500ms auto interval) so the 3D camera is not reset while rotating during live training.

nodes.name: Temml-Local.css
nodes.summary: Local copy of the Temml (MathML) stylesheet: @font-face for the Temml.woff2 script font plus presentation rules that make native MathML render correctly — math font stack, menclose/cancel/vec/polyline accents, browser-specific italic corrections, array cell padding, and CSS-counter-based AMS equation numbering.
nodes.languageNotes: Vendored Temml asset (not authored); uses @supports and @-moz-document url-prefix() to branch Chromium/WebKit/Firefox rendering quirks and clip-path/SVG-mask tricks for \cancel, \vec, and long division.

nodes.name: Temml-Local.min.css
nodes.summary: Minified build (clean-css v5.3.3, from temml@0.13.1 on jsDelivr) of Temml-Local.css providing the same MathML presentation rules in a single minified line.

nodes.name: temperaturelab.js
nodes.summary: Interactive demos for the temperature/sampling lesson (German-language UI): a temperature-slider softmax over fixed logits with a live bar chart, a cumulative-probability word sampler, a sinusoidal positional-encoding heatmap, and a toy RLHF reward/penalty feedback widget.

nodes.name: toc.js
nodes.summary: Builds a minimalist, self-contained table of contents for lesson pages: it walks the headings in #contents, assigns deduplicated slugs, computes per-section reading times from word counts, renders a collapsible tree with a search filter and expand/collapse-all toolbar, and persists expansion state to localStorage per page.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a flat element index + Range to slice each heading's section text in O(N) rather than a tree-walk per heading, and renders MathJax on a detached clone to strip LaTeX source and citation-SVG metadata before reading the TOC title.

nodes.name: todo_coherent_world_models.md
nodes.summary: A detailed consistency audit comparing the 'coherent world models' PHP lesson against its 19-file Coq formalisation: file-by-file gap analysis (licences hard-coded True, the Convention T object-vs-meta-level error, incomplete sheaf condition, the inconsistent identification_forbidden axiom) and a final verdict that the Coq files are structurally faithful but substantively thin.

nodes.name: todo_new.txt
nodes.summary: Short German authoring note flagging 1202 / Fibonacci's introduction of Hindu-Arabic numerals and the zero as a historically pivotal, under-covered point to weave into the book's Stone-Age opening.

nodes.name: todo.txt
nodes.summary: A scratch list of research and inspiration links for the book — arXiv papers (lottery ticket hypothesis, inductive backdoors, Llull), D2L attention visualization, Seeing Theory, Complexity Explorables, ciechanowski, redblobgames, karpathy's convnetjs, and other references to mine for lessons and visualizations.

nodes.name: topics.js
nodes.summary: The blog's personalization engine (window.BlogTopics): a 🎯 interest picker with ~27 topics, tone 'categories' (suppress/include filters), a 0-100 math-comfort slider, audience presets (profile x level), classic reader personas, and per-lesson 'learned'/dependency tracking. It preprocesses [[t:...]] markdown into toggleable topic blocks, scores each unit (full/partial/off) against the reader's dials, and tucks/dims/reveals in-lesson sections and home-page course tiles with animated height transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Single IIFE; preference state lives in a cookie (topics_pref, size-guarded to ~4KB) mirrored to localStorage (blog_topics_pref), with an in-memory undo/redo history, a marked.js block extension for [[t:...]] markers, and a 'depsMet' bypass that auto-reveals math-gated blocks once all prerequisites are marked learned.

nodes.name: transformer_layer_summary.js
nodes.summary: A self-booting panel that measures the blog transformer's live weights and explains, purely by the math, what each layer is doing: per-head attention entropy/focus, stable rank of the query-key and value-output blocks, dead FFN units, head similarity, and how hard each layer writes into the residual stream — rendered as per-layer cards (plain-language descriptions, expandable number tables, and a training sparkline), inserting itself next to the TDA-live section and refreshing every 1.2s during training.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.TransformerLayerSummary {refresh,current}; reads globals (forwardOneLayer, embedTokensWithPE, currentWeights, lossHistory) and runs its own tiny linear algebra (mul, transpose, power-iteration sigmaMax, stable rank) on the probe-token activations.

nodes.name: typography_fix.js
nodes.summary: Butterick-style silent typographic autocorrect for the blog: converts straight quotes, hyphen/dash runs, and '...' ellipses inside .md text nodes, then lints for what it missed. Exposed as window.TypographyFix {version, fixTypography, lint}.
nodes.languageNotes: Walks only safe text nodes via a TreeWalker (skipping code/pre/math/.no-typo-fix), runs once on DOMContentLoaded + the blogPostLoadComplete event, and a debounced MutationObserver catches late inserts from Toc/MathJax/lab modules.

nodes.name: vis_ideas.txt
nodes.summary: German brainstorm of advanced embedding-space visualization concepts for the book: manifold intersections/knots, frequency-dependent Voronoi 'ghost' boundaries, Riemannian curvature vector fields, hubness gravitation centers, manifold phase-transition kinks, low-rank subspaces, antipodal opposite-pairs, attractor networks, semantic density clouds, and linear relational embeddings.

nodes.name: wordpress_code.html
nodes.summary: A WordPress embed snippet that hosts the asanAI blog inside an auto-resizing iframe pointing at /asanai_blog_proxy.php, with a window 'message' listener that grows the iframe height in response to height postMessages from the page.

nodes.name: pcaRows
nodes.summary: Projects the analysis point cloud to 2D/3D via PCA, using covariance power iteration with deflation; switches to the covariance matrix for narrow data and the Gram (dual) trick for wide data, returning projected coords, the basis, the mean, and explained-variance fractions.

nodes.name: makeProjector
nodes.summary: Builds a model-space-to-display-space projection object (and its inverse) for the chosen method — slice / native / PCA / auto, exposing toDisp/toModel/projectors so flow and states can be drawn and lifted back, with PCA fit, center, and explained variance attached.

nodes.name: computeH0Persistence
nodes.summary: Computes 0-dimensional persistent homology over a distance matrix by Kruskal-style union-find edge insertion, returning the birth/death (persistence) of each connected-component merge plus the eternal component.

nodes.name: computeH1Persistence
nodes.summary: Computes 1-dimensional persistent homology by detecting 2-cycles (edges that close a bounded loop) via BFS path-length on the growing adjacency, capping the edge set and returning the top-40 most persistent loops.

nodes.name: computeBettiCurve
nodes.summary: Turns a persistence list into a Betti curve: for a sweep of scale epsilon, counts the number of features of the given dimension alive at that scale, producing the (epsilon, betti) points for the Betti-epsilon plot.

nodes.name: computeVectorField
nodes.summary: Evaluates the residual-stream flow on a 2D/3D grid in a shared display frame, computing the divergence via central differences and then detecting attractors (negative divergence) and repellers (positive divergence) on that field.

nodes.name: detectExtrema
nodes.summary: Selects the strongest divergence minima (sinks/attractors) or maxima (sources/repellers) on the grid with a small minimum separation, returning up to a handful of labelled extrema centers.

nodes.name: integrateStreamlines
nodes.summary: Integrates seed points along the flow field with a scaled step, recording the trail of each state until it converges to an attractor or leaves the bounds, producing the streamline traces drawn in the phase plot.

nodes.name: computeBasins
nodes.summary: For a 2D field, integrates a few flow steps from each grid cell and assigns the cell to the nearest attractor, producing a basin-of-attraction index grid (heatmap) with usage counts.

nodes.name: buildResidualStream
nodes.summary: Forward-passes the probe tokens through every transformer layer via embedTokensWithPE + forwardOneLayer, collecting the hidden state after each layer into the residual-stream tensor that the rest of the analysis reads.

nodes.name: computeWeightDeltas
nodes.summary: Computes, per layer, the Frobenius/euclidean norm of the change (W - W_prev) in each weight matrix and bias (query/key/value/output, gamma, beta, W1/b1, W2/b2) plus a per-layer total norm, used for the learning-field heatmap and the ΔW trajectory.

nodes.name: computeFrame
nodes.summary: Assembles the full analysis frame for the current mode: builds the point cloud and projector, computes topology, the cached vector field (+ streamlines/basins), the per-layer emergence sweep, and per-layer topology, returning one structured object the renderers consume.

nodes.name: computeLayerSweep
nodes.summary: Runs a coarse flow field on every residual layer in a shared frame, measures each attractor/repeller's 'ownership' (how many token states it captures) and drift, then matches centers across consecutive layers into tracks that show where each feature is born and how it evolves.

nodes.name: renderPhase
nodes.summary: Renders the main phase-space plot: routes to the residual-stream or weight-space view, composes the basins heatmap, divergence contour, 2D arrows / 3D cones, streamlines, attractor/repeller markers, the token point cloud, layer/epoch trails, and attention-flow segments, then Plotly.react's it.

nodes.name: captureEpoch
nodes.summary: Public entry point transformer.js calls each training epoch: builds a snapshot from the snapshot payload (residual stream, weight deltas, attention), appends it to the epoch history (bounded), and triggers a queued render when auto mode is on.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the TDA-live panel: subscribes to the AttentionEngine onForward hook for attention-flow data, populates the layer selector, syncs config, wires all controls, and handles the <details> open/toggle that unlocks live capture.

nodes.name: updateSamplingChart
nodes.summary: Recomputes the temperature-softmax probabilities over the fixed logits (exp(logit/temp) normalized) and redraws the probability bar chart, returning the words and probs for the sampler.

nodes.name: sampleWord
nodes.summary: Draws a random value and walks the cumulative probability distribution to pick a word, writing the chosen word and the random value into the output element.

nodes.name: drawPositionalEncoding
nodes.summary: Builds the sinusoidal positional-encoding matrix (sin/cos over positions and embedding dims) and renders it as a Viridis Plotly heatmap of the pattern.

nodes.name: giveFeedback
nodes.summary: Toy RLHF feedback widget: given positive/negative feedback it shows a +1.0 reward or -1.0 penalty message and gives the AI response box a brief scale 'learning' animation.

nodes.name: loadTemperatureModule
nodes.summary: Module entry point: sets the loading status, performs the initial chart render, draws the positional-encoding heatmap, wires the temperature slider, and resolves so it fits the lesson module queue.

nodes.name: toc
nodes.summary: Main builder: collects the lesson's headings, assigns dedup slugs, computes section reading times, renders the collapsible TOC tree + toolbar (search, expand/collapse all) and footer, restores persisted expansion, and enables transitions after first paint.

nodes.name: slugify
nodes.summary: Converts a heading's title text into a URL-safe slug (Unicode-aware, whitespace→dash), appending a counter to guarantee uniqueness against the usedIds set so anchor links never collide.

nodes.name: getHeaderTitle
nodes.summary: Extracts a heading's clean display title by cloning it, stripping math annotations/anchor links/svg/img, and rendering any inline LaTeX on the detached clone so the raw $...$ source and citation MIME metadata don't leak into the TOC.

nodes.name: getSectionText
nodes.summary: Returns all the text between a heading and the next heading of the same-or-higher level using a document Range bounded by a precomputed flat element index, used to measure a section's reading time.

nodes.name: countWords
nodes.summary: Counts word tokens in a string with a Unicode-aware regex (matching letter runs), ignoring pure numbers/punctuation, to feed the reading-time estimate.

nodes.name: formatReadingTime
nodes.summary: Converts a word count into a human reading-time label (~220 wpm), bucketing to '< 1 min' / '1 min' / rounded minutes.

nodes.name: applyFilter
nodes.summary: Filters the TOC to entries whose link text matches the query, marks matched items and their ancestors, and hides everything else (clearing the filter restores the full tree).

nodes.name: setAllExpanded
nodes.summary: Expands or collapses every collapsible TOC branch at once (updating the chevron glyphs) and saves the resulting state to localStorage.

nodes.name: preprocess
nodes.summary: Registers a marked.js block extension that recognizes [[t:id,...]]...[[/t]] markers and renders the inner (recursively preprocessed) markdown as a <div class="topic-block" data-topic="..."> that the visibility engine later tucks or reveals.

nodes.name: applyVisibility
nodes.summary: The core visibility pass: scores every managed block/tile (data-topic/data-tags/data-mathlevel) via scoreUnit, reconciles each to full/partial/off (tuck, dim, or plain-language math alt), regroups tucked home-page tiles, dims non-index course tiles, and re-renders inline widgets — with an optional ~220ms height animation.

nodes.name: scoreUnit
nodes.summary: Given a unit's tag ids and optional math requirement, decides its display state (full/partial/off) and the single binding reason (category/interests/layman/math), applying the layman lens, graded interest match, and the math-comfort gate (bypassed when all lesson prerequisites are learned).

nodes.name: applyMathAlts
nodes.summary: Swaps heavy LaTeX equations for their plain-language .math-alt twins whenever a listed 'suppress' tone category is switched off, so readers who muted math-heavy content get the simple version without losing the original.

nodes.name: showLearnedUI
nodes.summary: Builds the per-lesson learned/progress UI: a status pill at the top showing 'Lesson N of M' with a progress bar and 'Next up' link, the spine 'Builds on' prerequisite chips (each one-tap-markable as learned) and 'unlocks' list, plus the bottom 'Mark this lesson as learned' button pinned to the end of the content.

nodes.name: toggleLearned
nodes.summary: Toggles a lesson's learned flag in the persisted preference (pushing an undo step) and re-persists, which re-reveals math-gated blocks whose prerequisites are now all learned.

nodes.name: getLessonId
nodes.summary: Resolves the current lesson's id from a [data-lesson-id] element, falling back to the URL slug, so learned/dependency tracking and the progress pill target the right lesson.

nodes.name: applyAudience
nodes.summary: Applies a curated (profile, level) audience preset by enabling exactly the topics in that 4x4 matrix cell and remembering the selection (preserving the reader's tone-category dials, which are a separate axis).

nodes.name: applyPersona
nodes.summary: Loads a classic reader-type persona's curated topic set in one click (or enables everything for the Polymath), leaving the audience profile/level untouched, and flashes a confirmation hint.

nodes.name: applyCorePersona
nodes.summary: Toggles a core persona (Curious/Scientist/Thinker/Polymath) on or off; personas are combinable as a union of their topics, Polymath is exclusive, and toggling one off disables any topics no longer covered by the remaining active personas.

nodes.name: renderInlineWidget
nodes.summary: Renders the in-page topics widget for [data-topics-inline] hosts in three flavours (simple persona cards, detailed grid, or the classic full grid), wiring persona/personal toggles, tone chips, the math-comfort slider, and the 'open interest picker' link with an animated swap on expand/collapse.

nodes.name: regroupTuckedTiles
